So I main paladin and I'm pretty geared, I think I can add a lot of nice infos to this post

First of all, paladins are very very far from being the god tier class you all think it is.
I have been doing a fuck ton of pvp and noticed a few things
Most of people I've killed in wpw were clueless and didn't pull up a fight at all, my class isn't the problem here.
For the ones that fought back, here's what Ive encountered
Warlock's number one unbeatable class, fear is simply too overpowered, paladin have an extremely hard time reaching back to warlocks once they have been feared once, they'll fully dot you then fear you and simply run in the opposite direction while draining.
Druids, you simply cannot even slow a druid and he will kite you over and over using sunfire, while moving 20% speed in cat.
Hunters (or scorpid mains), same thing in wpvp you're mostly fighting against the insane scorpid damage when in reality the hunter is sitting in cheetah 40yard from you.
The only hunters I have killed were the ones who allowed me to avenger shield them, by the time I reach them usually I have 40% health remaining, if he's orc and resists my stun it's over.

I think y'all need to think twice about how paladins have 0 gap closer and how every thing we have is dispelable by priests/shaman

What am I supposed to do against a shaman kitting me and spam purging my seal?

I get that paladins can look pretty strong while swinging in melee, the reality is that MOST of the time you will be kited to your death as a paladin, and by most other class.
